original: No way... so we'll still be\ntrapped here in the fog?
Rejoice, Chosen Children! I found\na hint about how to defeat\nVamdemon!
I found a poem in some ancient\nruins, with a prophecy.
A flock of bats blotted out the\nsun.
The masses chanted the name of the\nundead Digimon king.
When the clock struck the number\nof the beast, the undead Digimon\nking revealed himself.
The angels shot arrows of hope and\nlight into the loved ones of those\nthey were summoned to protect...
and a miracle happened. Anyway, I\nwish you luck.
He said it was a hint, but it's\njust a load of gibberish. Doesn't\nhe know how to clear up this fog?
Taichi, we should find Mom and Dad\nright now.
Let's get out of here for now...
I thought we'd only have to deal\nwith the fog, but now this...
Yeah, the Bakemon didn't find him\nbecause he was hiding in a closet.
I'm still in medical school. But\nthere's no time for chit-chat, we \nneed to take care of these people.
If you give them time, they'll\nwake up, right? Mom...
What did you want to talk with me\nabout?
While we were hiding from the\nmonsters, your mom and I discussed\nthis, and we decided to tell you,
The truth is, we're not your real\nparents.
I pretended I hadn't heard and\ntried to act the same as I had\nbefore.
But in the end, I couldn't do it.\nSo I got absorbed in my computer\nto hide my true self.
It's fine to be interested in\ncomputers!
It's fine for you to have your own\ninterests... but you really are\nexactly like your real father.
He was a distant relative and a\ngenius mathematician.
We were planning to tell you when\nyou grew up, but... I'm sorry.
Thank you for telling me the\ntruth.
You don't have to force yourself.
Yes, all we want for you is to be\nhappy. We don't need any more than\nthat.
Koushirou, just let those tears\nout! Don't worry 'bout havin' it\nall to yourself!
They're covering the sky! And the\nsun!
"A flock of bats blotted out the\nsun..."
Heh heh heh. The true moment of\nterror is about to begin!
The prophecy, right? "The masses\nchanted the name of the undead\nDigimon king."
We saw bats, too. Just like the\nprophecy said.
What was the third part of the\nprophecy?
"When the clock struck the number\nof the beast, the undead Digimon\nking revealed himself..."
666. A number from the Book of\nRevelation.
666 would be... 6:06 and 6\nseconds? In that case, it's almost\ntime!
Hahaha, looks like you're\nspeechless in front of Lord\nVenomVamdemon's form.
If you need food, I've secured it.\nCome, I'll lead you there!
We won't let you eat everyone!
We have to do something about\nthis!
Haha... Hahahahahaha! You're\nsaying you're gonna destroy me?
Is that monster supposed to be a\nPerfect-level Digimon?
That's it! The rest of the\nprophecy!
If Angemon and Angewomon are the\n"angels"...
then who are "those they were\nsummoned to protect"?
Takeru and Hikari! Now as for\n"their loved ones"...
I'll do the explainin'. If I were\nan angel...
The people I love the most are my\nmom and dad. So Hikari and\nTakeru's loved ones...
But why do we have to shoot arrows\ninto their loved ones?
Well, Cupid fires arrows of love!
Right-o! Angemon and Angewomon can\nlet loose their arrows o' love.
And my hope! Shoot those arrows\ninto Yamato and Taichi!
I'm not scared ...well, actually,\nif I said that, I'd be lying.
Honestly, so am I. Hold onto me\ntight, so I won't run away.
Got it. Do the same for me, too.
Ultimate level! They evolved to\nUltimate-level Digimon!
What's that monster in his belly?!
It must be Vamdemon's true form!\nLet's settle this once and for\nall!
I'm Plotmon. Nice to meet you.
Agumon and Gabumon evolved to\nUltimate level, but they used up a\nlot of energy...
And so did Tailmon. I guess that's\nwhy she returned to her Child\nform.
It's been a long time since we've\ngot the whole family together,\nhasn't it, Yamato?
I wonder if my parents are okay...
Everyone's families are safe!\nThey're back to normal!
Hey, look! The fog's clearing up.
It does kind of look like it, now\nthat you mention it.
No, that's not the Digimon world\nwe were in anymore...
You're right. It's already been a\nfew days since we came here...
which means many years have passed\nin the Digimon world.
We came here without fixing the\ndistortions in the Digimon\nworld...
so has something really bad\nhappened on the other side?
And could that have affected our\nworld?
Let's go check it out. Let's go\nback to the Digimon world!
But how do we get back?
The first time we went to the\nDigimon world, we were brought\nthere by the Digivices...
So they should work this time,\ntoo!
Yeah! We might as well try!
All right! Everyone, put your\nDigivices together!
Please! Take us back to the\nDigimon world!
If we ride this light, we can go\nback to the Digimon world.
Yeah, we can take this back!
Sorry to do this just when\neveryone gathered here, but we'll \nbe leaving for a bit!
At this rate, Earth will be done\nfor! So I'll protect you, Mom, and\nthe others!
I believe in Koushirou and the\nothers.
Don't worry! We'll come back for\nsure!
